answer: [GitHub REST API 2022-11-28] To assign a user when creating an issue,
answer_full:
[GitHub REST API 2022-11-28] To assign a user when creating an issue, include the **`assignee`** field in the request body with the login name of the user you want to assign.

**Example (API 2022‑11‑28)**  

```http
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "title": "Bug report",
  "body": "Details of the bug...",
  "assignee": "octocat"
}
```

The `assignee` property is a string containing the login of the user to which the issue will be assigned[gh:p4:spec:create-an-issue:0].

answer: [GitHub REST API 2022-11-28] To assign a single user when creating an
answer_full:
[GitHub REST API 2022-11-28] To assign a single user when creating an issue with API version **2022‑11‑28**, include the **`assignee`** field in the JSON body of the request:

```http
POST https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues
Accept: application/vnd.github+json
Authorization: token YOUR_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "title": "Issue title",
  "body": "Description of the issue",
  "assignee": "username_of_assignee"
}
```

- **`assignee`** – a string containing the login name of the user to which the issue should be assigned[gh:p4:spec:create-an-issue:0].
